fusions.name: Belfry Rattle
fusions.desc: Rattles your chains, which deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each with [Vibrant Echo] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drained on the Hook
fusions.desc: Hooks an enemy at or below 30% health for 24 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dark Rafters
fusions.desc: Hauls you up into the dark and veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later and you move 17% faster. Attacking breaks the veil.

fusions.name: Night Roost
fusions.desc: At night, your dodge chance rises by 15%.
